scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Huh? Do I know you? It's creepy that you seem so familiar. You don't have a twin, do you?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
咦？我認識你嗎？
你看起來好眼熟，真是讓人毛骨悚然。
你該不會有個雙胞胎吧？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What, do you want to be a Thief? I'm sorry, but you look like you need more training.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
什麼，你想成為盜賊？
抱歉，你看起來還需要更多訓練。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Take your time and learn all the Basic Skills, will you? Well then, see you later~!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
慢慢來，把基本技能都學會，好嗎？
那麼，下次再見啦~！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Well, I got this feeling like you've been through a lifetime of fighting, so I'm promoting you to a Thief right this minute. I better give you tough guys what you want...
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
總覺得你像是打了一輩子的仗。
好，現在就讓你轉職成盜賊。
你們這些狠角色想要什麼，我還是照辦的好...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Since you've become a Thief, live as a Thief. Now, go for it! Next~
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
既然你成為了盜賊，就要像盜賊一樣生活。
去吧！下一個~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, dude.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, baby~
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿，寶貝~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, dude.
...Hey! You look too goody-goody to want to be a Thief!! Now scram, I'm busy. Next!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿，夥計。
...嘿！你看起來太正經了，不像想當盜賊的樣子！！
快走吧，我很忙。下一個！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, baby.
...Hey! You look too goody-goody to want to be a Thief!! Now scram, I'm busy. Next!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿，寶貝。
...嘿！你看起來太正經了，不像想當盜賊的樣子！！
快走吧，我很忙。下一個！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
If you have a problem, feel free to speak to me anytime, alright?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
如果你有問題，隨時可以來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Huh.
Now, that's
a big sword.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
搞什麼...？
嚯，這劍可真大。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
What's a Mage doin' here? Shouldn't you be doing card tricks elsewhere? Oh well, it's a free country...
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
搞什麼...？
魔法師來這兒幹嘛？
你不是該去別處玩紙牌魔術嗎？
算了，反正這兒來去自由...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
You're a Merchant,
right? Why are you
walking into a den
of Thieves?!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
搞什麼...？
你是商人吧？
怎麼跑到盜賊窩裡來了？！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Oh my God...
Am I dying?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
搞什麼...？
我的天...
難道我要死了？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Didn't you use to be one of us?! Man, you changed. You seem real dangerous now...
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
搞什麼...？
你以前不是我們的人嗎？！
夥計，你變了，現在看起來真危險...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Man, you got real cool all of a sudden! You must have some skills I can only dream of!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
搞什麼...？
夥計，你怎麼突然這麼酷了！
你的本領，我怕是做夢都學不來！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
搞什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Man, shouldn't you
Archers be playing
in the forest
or something?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
搞什麼...？
夥計，你們弓箭手不是該在森林裡玩兒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
You know we all steal for a living, right? What are you doing in this kinda place, Acolyte?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
搞什麼...？
你知道我們都是靠偷東西過活的吧？
服事，你來這種地方幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
So...
Trying to make
up for something
...Buddy?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
所以...
你這是想彌補什麼不足嗎...夥計？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Oh wait,
it's not...
Get outta here!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
哦，等等，不是...
滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
It's like you're begging
us to steal from you!
Come on, hurry and
get outta here~
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
你這簡直是在求我們偷你的東西！
行了，趕緊出去~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Why else would a Priest come here? I guess I better start confessing all of my misdeeds.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
牧師來這裡，還能為了什麼？
看來我得趕緊把自己的壞事都招了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
*Sigh* Look, there's really no need for you to be in this kind of place. You oughta go where you ought to go.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
*嘆氣*聽著，你真沒必要待在這種地方。
該去哪兒就去哪兒吧。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hmmm?
You gathered Mushrooms for
the Thief test, right?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嗯？
你去採盜賊考試要用的蘑菇了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Here, talk to the other guy right next to me. He's the one in charge of checking your Mushrooms.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
找我旁邊那個人吧，他負責檢查你帶來的蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
So how was the
Mushroom Farm?
Have any fun?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
蘑菇農場怎麼樣？
玩得開心嗎？

scripts.text: Yeah, kinda Cool.
scripts.translation: 是啊，還挺有意思

scripts.text: It was horrible.
scripts.translation: 糟透了

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Heh heh! That's a good attitude. In our line of work, you gotta enjoy getting your hands dirty, one way or another.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿嘿！
這態度不錯。
幹我們這行，總得樂意幹些不乾淨的活兒。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Yeah? I've been there too, so I can see why that place isn't everyone's cup of tea. Still, being a Thief isn't all glamour and trendy night life.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
是嗎？
我也去過，知道那地方不是誰都喜歡的。
不過，當盜賊可不光是風光體面、夜夜瀟灑。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, whaddya doin' here? Aren't you supposed to be gathering Mushrooms? Or did you need it explained to you again?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿，你在這兒幹嘛？不是應該去採蘑菇嗎？還是說你需要我再解釋一遍？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No, that's okay.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
*Sigh* Well, there's always one in the bunch. Alright, listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
*嘆氣*總有那麼幾個記不住的。
好，仔細聽。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, for your test, you gotta steal Mushrooms from a farm. Don't worry, the guy who owns the farm deserves to be robbed.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
考試要你去農場偷蘑菇。
別擔心，那個農場主被偷也是活該。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Anyway, you gotta gather two kinds of Mushrooms: ^0000FFOrange Net Mushrooms^000000 and ^0000FFOrange Gooey Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
總之，你得采集兩種蘑菇：^0000FF毒香菇^000000和^0000FF惡臭香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Be careful, since there are monsters are the farm that are there to protect the Mushrooms. So this will be no walk in the park.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
小心，農場裡有魔物守著蘑菇。
這趟可不輕鬆。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
When you come back here after gathering Mushrooms, you'll be graded on the Mushrooms you've collected.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
採完蘑菇回來，我們會根據你帶來的蘑菇評分。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Each Orange Net Mushroom gets you 3 points, and you get 1 point for each Orange Gooey Mushroom. You need a total of 25 points to pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
每顆毒香菇算3分，每顆惡臭香菇算1分。
總分達到25分，就能通過考試。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Go outside and keep going ahead toward the Eastern Field of the Pyramids. Then you will see one of our comrades between two columns.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
出去後，繼續往金字塔東邊的野外走。
你會在兩根柱子之間看到我們的一個同夥。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Speak to that guy, and he'll take you to the farm through the backdoor.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
找他談談，他會帶你從後門進入農場。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
On that field, I think his coordinates are '^FF0000141, 125^000000.' Just type ^3355FF/where^000000 in the right side of your chat box to check your present coordinates.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
他在那片野外的座標，我記得是“^FF0000141, 125^000000”。
在聊天框右側輸入^3355FF/where^000000，就能檢視自己當前的座標。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Huh. For a second there, I thought you had something really important to tell me.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
哼，剛才我還以為你有什麼要緊事呢。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What brings you down
here to this rathole?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
什麼風把你吹到這個老鼠洞來了？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Ah...
You came back.
Are you sure you're
ready to try again?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
啊，你回來了。
確定準備好再試一次了？

scripts.text: Hey, I came here to be a Thief!
scripts.translation: 嘿，我來這裡是為了成為盜賊！

scripts.text: Nah, I'm just looking around.
scripts.translation: 沒，我只是隨便看看

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Heh, I like your confidence. Still, you know being a Thief isn't all what it's cracked up to be.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿，我喜歡你這份自信。
不過，當盜賊可沒別人吹得那麼好。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Still...
Do you really
want to be
a Thief?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
不過...
你真的想當盜賊？

scripts.text: Yeah.
scripts.translation: 是啊

scripts.text: No, just wasting your time.
scripts.translation: 不，就是來浪費你時間的

scripts.text: Why did you become a Thief?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼成為盜賊？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Really...
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Yeah...
I can see that.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
是啊...
我看出來了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Me...?
I had no choice at the time. It was either steal or starve. But it's not like I need to give you my life story.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
我...？
那時候沒得選，不偷就得餓死。
不過，我也沒必要跟你交代這輩子的事。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
So do you want to
apply to become
a Thief or not?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
所以，你到底要不要申請當盜賊？

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是，我願意

scripts.text: I'm too scared to be a Thief!
scripts.translation: 當盜賊太嚇人了！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, tell
me your name.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
好吧，告訴我你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
{0}?
What kind of name is {1}? Anyway, give me a second.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
{0}？
{1}是什麼怪名字？
算了，等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, your registration has been processed. Okay, you can begin your test if you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
好，已經登記好了。
準備好了，就可以開始考試。

scripts.text: Yeah, I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 準備好了

scripts.text: No, I'm not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒準備好

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Not ready?
How can you
not be ready?!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
沒準備好？
怎麼還沒準備好？！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Too scared?!?
Hahahahahahah!
Oh, please...!
That's hilarious!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
太害怕了？！
Hahahahahahah!
拜託...！
真是笑死我了！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Okay...
Give me
one second.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
好...
等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Your name is...
{0}? Um, where is it? Ah, here it is. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
你叫...{0}？
嗯，記在哪兒了？
啊，找到了。
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Isn't that cute? I can see you're ambitious, but you gotta learn all of the Basic Skills before you can become a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
喲，還挺可愛。
看得出你有志氣，不過想當盜賊，得先學會所有基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright. I looked at your Felony Record, and you seem to have a very interesting history. You might have what it takes to be a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
好，我看過你的重罪記錄了，經歷還真有意思。
說不定，你真有當盜賊的潛質。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Because I feel like it, I now decree that you have passed this interview. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
我心情不錯，就宣佈你通過面試吧。
幹得好！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Now, your actual abilities will need to be tested. Do you know anything about the test?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
接下來，該考考你的實際本領了。
知道考試內容嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 知道

scripts.text: Sorry, I don't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，不知道

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Oh yeah? Well, this makes things a lot easier.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
哦，是嗎？
那就省事多了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, let me inform you then. Listen carefully. This test decides if you are worthy of becoming a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
好，那我來說明。
仔細聽，這場考試決定你有沒有資格當盜賊。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
You will be sneaking to Shibu's Farm. He is the worst Merchant, in terms of character, in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
你要潛入西布的農場。
那傢伙是夢羅克商人里人品最差的。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, for your test, you gotta steal Mushrooms from his farm. Don't worry, that guy deserves to be robbed.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
考試要你去他的農場偷蘑菇。
別擔心，那傢伙被偷也是活該。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Anyway, you gotta gather two kinds of Mushrooms: ^0000FFOrange Net Mushrooms^000000 and ^0000FFOrange Gooey Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
總之，你得采集兩種蘑菇：^0000FF毒香菇^000000和^0000FF惡臭香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Be careful, since there are monsters are the farm that are there to protect the Mushrooms. So this will be no walk in the park.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
小心，農場裡有魔物守著蘑菇。
這趟可不輕鬆。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
When you come back here after gathering Mushrooms, you'll be graded on the Mushrooms you've collected.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
採完蘑菇回來，我們會根據你帶來的蘑菇評分。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Each Orange Net Mushroom gets you 3 points, and you get 1 point for each Orange Gooey Mushroom. You need a total of 25 points to pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
每顆毒香菇算3分，每顆惡臭香菇算1分。
總分達到25分，就能通過考試。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Go outside and keep going ahead toward the Eastern Field of the Pyramids. Then you will see one of our comrades between two columns.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
出去後，繼續往金字塔東邊的野外走。
你會在兩根柱子之間看到我們的一個同夥。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Speak to that guy, and he'll take you to the farm through the backdoor.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
找他談談，他會帶你從後門進入農場。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
On that field, I think his coordinates are '^FF0000141, 125^000000.' Just type ^3355FF/where^000000 in the right side of your chat box to check your present coordinates.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
他在那片野外的座標，我記得是“^FF0000141, 125^000000”。
在聊天框右側輸入^3355FF/where^000000，就能檢視自己當前的座標。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Don't forget to make plans and prepare yourself before you go inside the Mushroom Farm. Move as quickly as you can and try not to get killed, alright?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
進蘑菇農場前，別忘了做好計劃，備齊東西。
動作儘量快些，可別把命丟了，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brad]
We don't have any special events yet. Come some other time when there's news, alright?
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
我們目前還沒有任何特別活動。等有新訊息的時候再來吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Um...
You don't look
like a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
嗯...
你看起來不像盜賊。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
What the heck are
you doing here anyway?
scripts.translation:
[同志]
你到底來這裡幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
What's the matter? If you want to be a Thief, speak to the girl beside me.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
怎麼了？
想當盜賊，就找我旁邊的女孩談談。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Did you pass the interview?
Then what are you waiting for?
scripts.translation:
[同志]
你通過面試了嗎？
那你在等什麼？

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Ah, the guide told me about you. So, let me check your mushrooms...
scripts.translation:
[同志]
啊，嚮導跟我說過你的事。
讓我看看你帶來的蘑菇...

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
What the hell...
You don't have any Mushrooms at all! Go back and get them. Otherwise, you won't pass the test and become a Thief!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
搞什麼鬼...
你一顆蘑菇都沒帶！
回去採來，不然可過不了考試，更當不了盜賊！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
First, let me check the Orange Net Mushrooms you got.
Huh, {0} of them.
Now I'll just check your Orange Gooey Mushrooms. That's {1} you gathered.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
先看看你採的毒香菇。
嗯，有{0}顆。
再看看惡臭香菇，有{1}顆。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Now I'll just check your Orange Gooey Mushrooms. That's {0} you gathered.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
再看看惡臭香菇，有{0}顆。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
First, let me check the Orange Net Mushrooms you got.
Huh, {0} of them.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
先看看你採的毒香菇。
嗯，有{0}顆。

scripts.text: [Comrade]
scripts.translation: [同志]

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
So that would
bring your total to...
scripts.translation:
[同志]
那麼，你的總分應該是...

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Hmmm. {0} degrees, multiplied by the speed of light, divided by the integral of pi times height plus the absolute value of politics...
scripts.translation:
[同志]
嗯，{0}度，乘以光速，再除以π乘高度的積分，加上政治的絕對值...

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Okay!
I got it.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
好了！
我算出來了。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Definitely less than the 25 points you need to pass. Go out there and get me more Mushrooms!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
肯定低於通過所需的25分。去外面給我多采點蘑菇！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
You got more
than 25 points!
Awesome!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
你超過了25分！
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Exactly 25 points!
You did it! Badass!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
正好25分！
你做到了！真厲害！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
{0}...
You have passed the official Thief Test. You are now one of us.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
{0}...
你通過了正式的盜賊測試。現在，你也是我們的一員了。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Congratulations on becoming a Thief! From now, be an honorable representative of the Thief's Guild.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
恭喜你成為盜賊！從現在開始，請作為盜賊公會的榮譽代表行事。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
If you bring disgrace to our guild, you will be killed. I expect you to bring our comrades pride.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
如果你給公會帶來恥辱，你會被處死。我期待你能為我們的同志帶來榮耀。

scripts.text:
[Brad]
*Ahem* Welcome to the Guild, comrade! I'm Brad, and I'm in charge of human resources here.
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
*咳* 歡迎加入公會，同志！我是布拉德，這裡負責人力資源。

scripts.text:
[Brad]
Here is a small subsidy for a Newbie like you. Spend it whereever you want. Alright then, I'll see you around~
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
這是給像你這樣的新人的小額補貼。你想怎麼花就怎麼花。那麼，回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Ah, I see that you are now a Thief. I always knew you'd join us.
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
啊，看來你現在已經是盜賊了。我一直知道你會加入我們。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Stealing from a Mushroom farm is too easy for you now. You should build up your skills and master our craft.
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
從蘑菇農場偷東西對你來說太簡單了。你應該磨練技藝，精通我們的手藝。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
I could use a good, hard drink.
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
我想來杯好酒，好好喝一頓。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Gimme your money.
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
把你的錢交出來。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
WHO YOU CALLING A PSYCHO?!?!
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
你說誰是瘋子？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
I've got nothing to say to you. Would you mind leaving me alone?
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
我沒什麼話想跟你說。你能不能別纏著我？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Today looks like a good day to go to the pyramids and hunt with some of my friends.
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
今天看起來是個好日子，適合去金字塔和朋友們一起打怪。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Kidding, I'm off the clock.
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
開玩笑的，我現在下班了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hahahahaha~!
You haven't
passed the test yet?
Alright, I'll let you in...
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
哈哈哈哈哈~！
你還沒通過測試嗎？
好吧，我讓你進去...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hmm...
You've come to take the test, right? I can see in your eyes that you know something.
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
嗯...
你是來接受測試的吧？我從你的眼神里看出你知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Your name is {0}? Ah, it's on the list. Alright, I'll let you into the Mushroom Farm , but I can't guarantee your safety...
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
你的名字是{0}？啊，在名單上。好吧，我讓你進入蘑菇農場，但我不能保證你的安全...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
There is this strange smell coming from... You. Now why would that be?
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
有一股奇怪的味道從...你身上散發出來。這到底是為什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hey Novice! Why don't you join the ranks of the Thief Guild? You newbies are always welcome to join us and our selfish cause.
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
嘿，初心者！要不要加入盜賊公會？我們隨時歡迎你們這些新人，一起為我們自私的事業效力。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
You can get more information in the Underground Room in the Pyramid 1 BF.
scripts.translation:
[無關先生]
你可以在金字塔地下1層的地下室裡獲取更多資訊。
